candidates.description: This vector represents a mixture of Japanese kana characters and isolated English alphanumeric strings acting as subword noise.
This vector is activated by tokens containing the letter 'K' or the corresponding Devanagari character sound 'KA'.
This vector activates on various non-English script characters, including Chinese and Devanagari characters.
This vector activates for non-English script fragments, including characters, syllables, and abbreviations from various international writing systems.
This vector represents individual characters from various non-Latin writing systems, including Devanagari and Chinese.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel signs and dependent consonant conjuncts used in Devanagari script.
This vector represents a multilingual fragment-level feature that activates on mixed subword tokens from Hindi and English.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and fragments specific to the Marathi language and Devanagari script.
This vector activates strongly on specific non-Latin script characters, Hindi syllables, and foreign language tokens.
This feature vector is related to common words, characters, and subwords in Hindi and other South Asian languages.
